query: I'm considering graduate school but I can't afford to quit my job. Should I do part-time or full-time?
atoms: perspective: Working professional pursuing a professional degree
perspective: Student pursuing a research-based or academic degree
perspective: Student with employer tuition reimbursement
plausible_answers: Answer A (Part-Time Default for Professional Degrees): Do a part-time program if you're pursuing a professional degree (MBA, MPA, MS) — you maintain income, apply learning immediately, avoid employment gaps, and outcomes are largely equivalent to full-time.

Answer B (Full-Time for Immersion and Research): Go full-time if you can fund it — the peer network, research opportunities, and immersive experience are difficult to replicate part-time, and for research-based degrees full-time is essentially required.

Answer C (Part-Time Only with Employer Support): Pursue part-time only if your employer offers tuition reimbursement — this eliminates the financial risk of part-time study and makes the math clearly favorable, but without employer support the burnout risk over 3–4 years is high.
